events.text: Practice room acoustic lining test compares two removable wall panels using a fixed speaker position. This is an exploratory studio exercise, not a certified sound-isolation rating. Keep room measurements distinct from the portable booth build, even when the same microphone is used.

Portable narration booth build aims to reduce room reflections around a standing narrator. Assemble a folding frame and removable lining. We will borrow the practice-room test kit, but the booth's transport weight is a separate design constraint.

Microphone calibration card C0 for the practice room acoustic lining test records a reference level of 93.6 dB. The reading belongs to the initial kit check before panel installation. The handwritten margin contains a battery inventory, not a second reference measurement.

Joint test-kit booking for the practice room acoustic lining test and portable narration booth build: leave the microphone stand at its marked height between sessions. Each project must save its own room description. A shared microphone does not make the two enclosures equivalent.
